raw.details:
BUILD BATTLE

AI × Web Development Hackathon

Build. Adapt. Ship. Compete.

Build Battle is a competitive AI-powered web development hackathon organized by Frontend Arena, designed to challenge developers to transform a common problem statement into a creative, functional, and intelligent web solution.

Every participant will work on the same Problem Statement, but the final outcome will depend entirely on their problem understanding, ideas, technical skills, creativity, AI integration, design, and execution.

Participants will build a web application that doesn't just look good, but solves a problem, creates value, and uses technology intelligently.

One Problem. Different Minds. Smarter Solutions. One Champion.

EVENT OVERVIEW

Build Battle is an individual-only competitive web development hackathon where participants compete against each other by building solutions for a common challenge.

The challenge combines Web Development, AI, Data, and Creative Problem Solving, giving participants the freedom to decide how they approach the problem and what technologies they use.

Participants can use modern web technologies, AI tools, APIs, datasets, and AI-powered platforms to enhance their solutions.

The goal is simple:

Understand the problem. Build the experience. Add intelligence. Stand out.

THE BUILD BATTLE PHILOSOPHY

Build Battle follows a simple development journey:

BUILD → ADAPT → SHIP → COMPETE

BUILD
Create a functional and engaging web experience.

ADAPT
Use data and AI where it meaningfully improves your solution.

SHIP
Turn your idea into a working, polished product.

COMPETE
Present your solution and compete against other builders.

Your implementation can be simple or ambitious.

The technology is your choice. The problem is the same.

PARTICIPATION

  • Individual Participation Only
  • Team participation is not allowed.
  • Open to students, developers, designers, freelancers, and web development enthusiasts.
  • Participants of all skill levels are welcome.
  • Participants can use their preferred web technologies.
  • AI-assisted development and Vibe Coding are allowed.

THE CHALLENGE

Every participant will receive the same official Problem Statement.

The objective is to transform that problem into a meaningful digital solution.

Participants are free to decide:

  • How they understand the problem
  • What features they build
  • How they design the interface
  • What technologies they use
  • Whether and how they integrate AI
  • How they use data
  • How they present their final solution

The challenge is not about building the most complicated project.

It is about building a solution that demonstrates:

Good Thinking + Good Design + Good Technology + Good Execution

AI & VIBE CODING

AI-assisted development and Vibe Coding are allowed.

Participants may use:

  • AI coding assistants
  • AI development tools
  • AI design tools
  • APIs
  • Datasets
  • Frameworks and libraries
  • AI-powered platforms
  • Other development tools

Participants may also integrate AI-powered functionality into their web applications where it meaningfully contributes to solving the problem.

AI can help participants:

  • Explore ideas
  • Prototype faster
  • Generate and improve code
  • Debug implementations
  • Analyze data
  • Build intelligent features
  • Experiment with AI-powered experiences

However, participants are expected to understand the solution they submit and should be able to explain their implementation when required.

AI can assist your development — but your ideas, decisions, and execution define your solution.

ADAPTION AI CREDITS

As part of Build Battle, participants will have an opportunity to explore Adaption and its AI capabilities.

$500 IN ADAPTION CREDITS FOR BUILDERS

Participants will receive access to $500 worth of Adaption credits to experiment with AI and data-driven components and explore how intelligent systems can complement their web applications.

$1,000 IN ADAPTION CREDITS FOR WINNERS

Every winner will receive $1,000 worth of Adaption credits to continue experimenting and building with the platform.

Participants can also learn more about Adaption through the event's live introduction/demo session and access support from the Adaption community and team.

Your web application is the product. AI is the intelligence behind the experience.

Specific usage of Adaption credits and available platform capabilities will be communicated to participants during the event.

EVALUATION CRITERIA

Criteria Weightage
Problem Understanding 15%
Functionality & User Experience 25%
UI/UX & Design 20%
Innovation & Creativity 15%
Technical Implementation 15%
Presentation & Demo 10%

Problem Understanding — 15%

How clearly does the solution address the given problem?

Functionality & User Experience — 25%

Does the application work effectively? Is the experience intuitive and useful?

UI/UX & Design — 20%

How polished, accessible, responsive, and visually engaging is the interface?

Innovation & Creativity — 15%

Does the participant bring an original approach or interesting idea to the problem?

Technical Implementation — 15%

How well is the solution technically implemented? This may include architecture, code quality, integrations, AI/data implementation, and overall engineering decisions.

Presentation & Demo — 10%

How effectively does the participant communicate the problem, solution, features, and technical approach?

RULES & GUIDELINES

  • Build Battle is strictly individual participation only.
  • Each participant must develop and submit their own solution.
  • All submissions must be based on the official Problem Statement.
  • Participants may use their preferred technologies unless otherwise specified.
  • Third-party libraries, frameworks, APIs, datasets, and development tools are permitted unless restricted by the Problem Statement.
  • AI-assisted development and Vibe Coding are permitted.
  • AI-powered features may be incorporated where relevant to the solution.
  • Participants must submit their project within the announced deadline.
  • Plagiarism, copied projects, or unauthorized use of another participant's work may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must ensure that any third-party assets, datasets, APIs, or resources they use comply with their respective licenses and terms.
  • Participants may be asked to explain their implementation during evaluation or the final presentation.
  • The organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the event rules.

WHO SHOULD PARTICIPATE?

Build Battle is for anyone interested in building for the web and experimenting with modern technology, including:

  • Students
  • Frontend Developers
  • Full-Stack Developers
  • Web Developers
  • UI/UX Designers
  • AI Enthusiasts
  • Freelancers
  • Beginners
  • Developers exploring AI-assisted development
  • Developers interested in building AI-powered web experiences

Whether you're just starting out or already building real-world products, Build Battle gives you a platform to put your skills to the test.

WHAT TO EXPECT

A REAL CHALLENGE

Everyone works on the same Problem Statement.

CREATIVE FREEDOM

Decide how you want to approach and solve the problem.

AI & VIBE CODING

Use modern AI tools to accelerate your development.

INTELLIGENT SOLUTIONS

Explore how AI and data can enhance your web experience.

DESIGN & DEVELOPMENT

Build an application that is functional, responsive, and visually engaging.

COMPETITIVE EVALUATION

Your solution will be evaluated against the same criteria as every other participant.

FINAL SHOWCASE

Present your solution and explain your approach.

CREDITS & RECOGNITION

Access Adaption credits, certificates, recognition, and opportunities to showcase your work.

BUILD WITH YOUR OWN STACK

Participants are free to choose the technologies that best fit their solution.

You can build using technologies such as:

HTML • CSS • JavaScript • React • Next.js • Vue • Angular • Svelte • Node.js • Python • APIs • Databases • AI Tools

and other technologies permitted by the official Problem Statement.

Your stack doesn't define your solution. Your execution does.

THE CHALLENGE IS SIMPLE

Everyone gets the same problem.

But nobody has to solve it the same way.

Your approach.
Your design.
Your technology.
Your intelligence.
Your execution.

ONE PROBLEM. DIFFERENT MINDS. SMARTER SOLUTIONS.

BUILD. ADAPT. SHIP. COMPETE.

Organized by Frontend Arena
